top_signals.title: Iran and Oman Hold Talks on Strait of Hormuz Security as Tanker Attacks Surge
top_signals.summary: The foreign ministers of Iran and Oman discussed on Tuesday the situation in the region and the importance of keeping security in the maritime corridors to ensure smooth flows of shipping and trade, Oman’s Foreign Ministry said. Oman’s Foreign Minister Sayyid Badr Albusaidi and his visiting Iranian counterpart, Abbas Araghchi, also talked about revitalizing channels for dialogue and negotiations. “These efforts aim to broaden areas of understanding among the parties concerned and prevent the crisis and its repercussions from escalating,”…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Autumn 2026 Economic Forecast shows continued growth amid higher inflation
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 17 Nov 2026 The EU economy held up better than expected in the first three quarters of 2026 and is set to keep expanding over the forecast horizon, despite stronger and more persistent inflationary pressures, as well as tighter financing conditions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
